data_description.name: A name for this Inception hub
data_description.token: An Inception User API token. Available under Users > Remote / Web Access > User API Token.
data_description.host: The host address of your Inception hub. If no protocol is specified, http:// will be used.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate with Inception
reauth_confirm.description: The API token for **{name}** was rejected by the Inception controller. Check the token under Users → Remote / Web Access → User API Token in the Inception web interface, then paste the current token below.

data_description.token: A valid Inception User API token.

init.description: Configure alarm code settings for your Inception alarm panels.

data_description.require_pin_code: When enabled, a code is required for area arming/disarming. If disabled, area operations will be performed as the user which is associated with the configured API token.
data_description.require_code_to_arm: When enabled, a valid code must be entered to arm the alarm. When disabled, a code is only required for disarming.

unlock.name: Unlock
unlock.description: Unlocks a door. If a time is provided, a timed unlock is used.

time_secs.name: Seconds
time_secs.description: Number of seconds to grant access.

area_arm.name: Area Arm
area_arm.description: Arms an area with custom exit delay and seal check settings.

exit_delay.name: Exit Delay
exit_delay.description: If true, puts the Area into Exit Delay mode for a specified length of time before the Area arms fully. The length of the exit delay time is determined by the Area item's settings in the Inception web interface.

seal_check.name: Seal Check
seal_check.description: If true, performs a seal check on the Inputs associated with this area. If any Inputs are found to be unsealed, the area will fail to arm.

code.name: Code
code.description: PIN code for arming the area. If omitted, defaults to the user which is associated with the configured API token.

get_review_events.name: Get review events
get_review_events.description: Queries historical review events from the Inception controller. Returns matching events as a service response. All fields are optional; leave them empty to fetch the most recent events.

entry_id.name: Inception hub
entry_id.description: Select which configured Inception hub to query. Only required when multiple hubs are configured.

limit.name: Limit
limit.description: Maximum number of events to return. Defaults to 100 when omitted.

offset.name: Offset
offset.description: Skip this many events before returning results. Use with 'limit' for pagination.

direction.name: Direction
direction.description: Sort order. 'Oldest first' (asc) is the default; 'Newest first' (desc) returns the most recent events.

start.name: Start
start.description: Earliest event timestamp to include. When using 'Newest first', this must be more recent than 'End'.

category_filter.name: Categories
category_filter.description: Only return events in one or more of the selected categories.

message_type_id_filter.name: Message type IDs
message_type_id_filter.description: Only return events whose numeric MessageID matches one of the supplied values. Provide a list of integers.

involved_entity_id_filter.name: Involved entity IDs
involved_entity_id_filter.description: Only return events whose WhoID, WhatID or WhereID matches one of the supplied entity IDs. Provide a list of UUID strings.

reference_id.name: Reference event ID
reference_id.description: Anchor pagination around a specific event. Pair with 'Reference time' (the event's WhenTicks value).

reference_time.name: Reference time
reference_time.description: WhenTicks value of the reference event. Must be supplied alongside 'Reference event ID'.

_.name: Review event received
_.description: Fires when a review event is received from the Inception system. All filter fields are optional; leave them empty to match every event.

message_category.name: Message category
message_category.description: Only fire when the event belongs to one of the selected categories.

message_value.name: Message ID
message_value.description: Only fire when the event's numeric MessageID matches one of the supplied values. See the Inception API documentation for the full list of IDs.

who_id.name: Who ID
who_id.description: Only fire when the event was raised by one of the listed Inception user/entity IDs.

what_id.name: What ID
what_id.description: Only fire when the event targets one of the listed Inception entity IDs (door, area, input, output, etc.).

where_id.name: Where ID
where_id.description: Only fire when the event occurred in one of the listed Inception area/location IDs.
